dedupe_keys.name: indoor outdoor and rooftop weather station measurements from a monitored building in crete 2025

description: This dataset contains environmental measurements from an Internet of Things sensor network installed in and around a monitored building in Crete, Greece, during 2025: indoor environmental monitoring, outdoor monitoring and meteorological observations from a roof-mounted weather station. It was published on Zenodo on 10 February 2026 by Athanasios Malisovas and Dionysia Kolokotsa; the installation was supported by the Horizon Europe project JUST Nature. Its stated purposes are research in environmental monitoring, building performance analysis, indoor air quality assessment and local meteorology. Coverage is one building in Crete for 2025. Access: a small ZIP file of about 0.3 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the building, variables and sampling interval are not described in the metadata read, and the small file size suggests aggregated or short series. Simulation uses: indoor overheating and outdoor microclimate analysis for heat adaptation and nature-based solutions. Related records: the ENVI-met Milan and Pescara microclimate data.
